title: Fill
suits: drinks, food and beverage, energy, health and hydration, fintech balances and progress: products about filling up, topping up or reaching a level

params.__MARK__: stroke paths in a 24 x 24 box; each stroke becomes a tube that fills with the rest

details: the outlines draw first, glyph by glyph, like glass being blown
the drawn outline hands over to a seamless glass ring, so overlapping contours never show seams
liquid rises inside mark and word together from below
the surface tilts back and forth as it rises and two ripples cross it, decaying
a few bubbles climb the strokes, wobble and pop at the surface with a tiny ring
it settles on one level line across mark and word: lowercase full, tall letters keep their empty tops
a meniscus highlight runs along the surface
the liquid is lighter at the top and deeper below, toward the depth tint
a soft glow of the liquid colour sits behind the lockup
after it settles the level breathes gently
